mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.movie_title FROM actors a JOIN movie_actors ma ON a.id = ma.actor_id JOIN movies m ON ma.movie_id = m.id WHERE a.name = #{actorName} ORDER BY m.movie_title

SELECT a.name AS actor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.movie_id) AS movie_count, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM actors a INNER JOIN movie_actors ma ON a.id = ma.actor_id INNER JOIN movies m ON ma.movie_id = m.id WHERE a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{actorName}, '%') GROUP BY a.id, a.name
